title: Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning on Amazon SageMaker AI: A hands-on guide
excerpt: This technical article explains why multi-step AI agent tasks need training signals for entire trajectories rather than single answers. It walks through multi-turn reinforcement learning using Amazon SageMaker AI and Bedrock AgentCore, including reward design, orchestration, training and evaluation.

title: Flint-interactive: A language for creating interactive data visualizations
excerpt: This research blog introduces Flint-interactive, a language for expressing interactive visualizations through semantic events and update operators. It aims to make agent-generated charts easier to explore while reducing low-level visualization code and debugging effort.

title: A curriculum for post-training agents
excerpt: This guide outlines a curriculum for post-training agents using supervised fine-tuning, distillation and reinforcement learning. Agentic post-training considers tool use and the sequence of turns rather than evaluating one answer in isolation.
